content: There is nothing noble in being superior to your fellow man; true nobility is being superior to your former self.
author: Ernest Hemingway
story:
Preserved as part of Ernest Hemingway's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of self improvement and courage. Across his life and work, Ernest Hemingway returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: Where does your life require a quiet act of courage from you before this week ends?
